next_common_gate.purpose: test whether forward EPS expectations are improving rather than merely high

current_evidence.fact: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 49% YoY in INR and 33% in USD.
Q1 FY27 PAT grew 110% YoY and EBITDA margin reached 20.3%.
Next-12-month signed order book reached USD 2.23bn, up 44% YoY.

companies.thesis: Exceptional execution plus strong executable order visibility can sustain industry-leading growth if acquisition integration and margins hold.
disconfirmation_questions: Does organic growth fall sharply once acquisition contribution is separated?
Does next-12-month order-book growth materially decelerate?
Do margins fall below management's FY27 trajectory despite revenue scale?

current_evidence.fact: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 16.3% YoY to about Rs 9,150 crore.
Q1 FY27 PAT grew 25.2% to about Rs 1,032 crore and operating EBITDA margin was about 21%.
The company retained a net-cash position after funding the Lannett acquisition and share buyback.

companies.thesis: Broad-based geographic growth, improving operating leverage and a moderate relative valuation create a stronger balance of growth and price than many radar peers.
disconfirmation_questions: Does US organic growth fail to return to double digits?
Does Lannett dilute margins or consume materially more cash than expected?
Do regulatory observations delay high-value launches or injectables capacity?

current_evidence.fact: Q1 FY27 revenue was about Rs 35,244 crore, up roughly 17% YoY.
Q1 EBITDA grew about 26% and normalized PAT about 55%.
Net leverage was reported at 0.8x while aerospace order book grew more than 17% from FY26 year-end.

companies.thesis: A globally diversified manufacturing platform is showing operating leverage while adding aerospace and electronics growth engines without currently excessive leverage.
disconfirmation_questions: Does EBITDA growth fall below revenue growth as new capex ramps?
Does net leverage rise materially above the current low level without matching earnings growth?
Do emerging businesses fail to offset weak global auto volumes?

current_evidence.fact: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew 32%, EBITDA 73% and PAT 75%.
India Aluminium, Copper and Novelis all reported record quarterly EBITDA.
Oswego restarted and Bay Minette commissioning is underway; net debt/EBITDA rose to 1.95x.

companies.thesis: The combination of Novelis recovery, strong India operations and low forward valuation can create substantial upside if current earnings are not primarily peak-cycle and Bay Minette earns its capital cost.
disconfirmation_questions: Do normalized margins fall materially when commodity tailwinds fade?
Does Bay Minette commissioning slip or require materially more capital?
Does net debt/EBITDA keep rising after the current capex phase?

current_evidence.fact: Q1 FY27 USD revenue grew 16.1% YoY and EBIT grew 32.7%.
Quarterly TCV reached a record USD 1.146bn.
Persistent secured 83.25% of Nagarro's outstanding share capital by the end of the initial takeover acceptance period.

companies.thesis: Persistent has strong organic digital-engineering execution and record bookings, but the Nagarro transaction now makes integration and capital allocation central to the thesis.
disconfirmation_questions: Does organic revenue growth slow materially before Nagarro contribution?
Does acquisition financing materially weaken return on capital or balance-sheet flexibility?
Do combined-company margins dilute without a credible recovery path?
